columns.expression: IF([Running Year]=1, "Running 12 Months", IF([Running Year]=2, "Running 13-24 Months", IF([Running Year]=3, "Running 25-36 Months", Blank())))
columns.label: Running Months
columns.source_expression: IF([Running Year]=1, "Running 12 Months", IF([Running Year]=2, "Running 13-24 Months", IF([Running Year]=3, "Running 25-36 Months", Blank())))

metrics.expression: IF(SUM('KPI'[KPI])=1,CONCATENATE(LEFT([Total Units YTD Var %2],3),(" % ROI (Return on Investment)")),IF(SUM('KPI'[KPI])=2," ",IF(SUM('KPI'[KPI])=3,CALCULATE([Total Category Volume],'Date'[Running Year]=1))))
metrics.label: KPI01

metrics.expression: IF(SUM('KPI'[KPI])=1,(CALCULATE([Total Category Volume],'Date'[Running Year]=1)),IF(SUM('KPI'[KPI])=2," ",IF(SUM('KPI'[KPI])=3,CONCATENATE(LEFT([Total Units YTD Var %2],3),"%"))))
metrics.label: KPI02

metrics.expression: IF([Total VanArsdel Units]=0, 0, DIVIDE([Total VanArsdel Units], [Total Units], 0))
metrics.label: % Units Market Share

metrics.expression: DIVIDE([Total VanArsdel Units YTD], [Total Units YTD])
metrics.label: % Units Market Share YTD

metrics.expression: CALCULATE([% Units Market Share YTD], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('Date'[Date]))
metrics.label: % Market Share SPLY YTD

metrics.expression: [% Units Market Share]-[% Units Market Share SPLY]
metrics.label: % Unit Market Share YOY Change

metrics.expression: IF([Total VanArsdel Units R12M]=0, 0, DIVIDE([Total VanArsdel Units R12M], [Total Units R12Ms], 0))
metrics.label: % Units Market Share R12M

metrics.expression: IF(ISBLANK(CALCULATE([Sentiment], Manufacturer[MfgisVanArsdel]="No"))||ISBLANK(CALCULATE([Sentiment], Manufacturer[MfgisVanArsdel]="Yes")), BLANK(), CALCULATE([Sentiment], Manufacturer[MfgisVanArsdel]="No") - CALCULATE([Sentiment], Manufacturer[MfgisVanArsdel]="Yes"))
metrics.label: Sentiment Gap

metrics.expression: DIVIDE([Total Units YTD Var],[TOTAL UNITS SPLY])
metrics.label: Total Units YTD Var %

metrics.expression: IF('SalesFact'[% Category Compete Share]<0.55,1,IF('SalesFact'[% Category Compete Share]>0.6,3,2))
metrics.label: @Indicator01

metrics.expression: IF('SalesFact'[% Unit Market Share YOY Change]<0,1,IF('SalesFact'[% Unit Market Share YOY Change]>.2,3,2))
metrics.label: @Indicator02

metrics.expression: IF('SalesFact'[Total Units YTD Var %]<0,1,IF('SalesFact'[Total Units YTD Var %]>0.1,3,2))
metrics.label: @Indicator03

metrics.expression: IF('SalesFact'[@Indicator04]=1,"Low Sentiment Rate",IF('SalesFact'[@Indicator04]=3,"High Sentiment Rate","Medium Sentiment Rate"))
metrics.label: @Indicator04A

metrics.expression: IF('SalesFact'[@Indicator05]=1,"Low Sentiment Gap",IF('SalesFact'[@Indicator05]=3,"High Sentiment Gap","Medium Sentiment Gap"))
metrics.label: @Indicator05A

metrics.expression: INT(DIVIDE([Total Units YTD Var],[TOTAL UNITS SPLY])*100)
metrics.label: Total Units YTD Var %2
